milestone: RAG fusion budget separation and source diversity
dataset: BEIR SciFact, full 5183-document corpus, existing 9189 production chunks
dev: All 809 official train queries; independent cross-encoder candidate score reuse for quality screening only
confirmation: All 300 official test queries, previously exposed; regression only, not a fresh blind holdout

selection_rule.choice: Eligible arms within 0.002 of best nDCG@10: prefer smaller rerank budget, then higher nDCG@10; otherwise baseline

scoring: Document dedup before metric cutoffs, using the fixed final 20 raw chunks; raw first-five-chunk gold availability is separately named
primary: nDCG@10: four paired comparisons vs baseline, 10000 gold-overlap cluster bootstrap, 98.75% Bonferroni intervals
secondary: Recall@5/10/20 and MRR@5/10; exploratory 95% paired cluster intervals
latency: Actual five-arm per-query randomized interleaving, shared warm models, concurrency 1; omit every arm of first query; mean/p50/p95 and paired cluster mean CI
runtime: Existing offline BGE-M3 dense, tokenizer log-TF plus Qdrant IDF sparse, BGE reranker-v2-m3; CUDA batch8; snapshot SQL join
limits: Retrieval only, no answer generation or ContextBudgetPolicy admission measurement, no API generation charges or fabricated token/dollar cost
compatibility: New budgets and soft source quota opt-in; old snapshots and default retrieval behavior preserved

_publication.policy: case text, source corpus, requests, credentials and per-case objects omitted
